paragraphs.text: The Bridge City of Telemar (TELL-em-ahr) connected the island of Corundis with mainland Corondor on Dominaria .
Telemar was built on top of Primor Bridge which connected Corundis to mainland Corondor .
Telemar was the birthplace of Gwendolyn Carthalion . Originally it was built as a fort to defend the island, but it grew into a city over the years. Eventually even House Sapphire moved to Telemar.
In the unpublished comic Planeswalkers War , Grenfell Mor was killed by Sandruu , and Telemar was destroyed when Leshrac activated the Grey Chime there.
